title: Ernie Garcia - Disrupting the Auto Buying Experience - [Founder’s Field Guide, EP. 45]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Ernie Garcia, co-founder and CEO of online used car platform, Carvana.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Ernie Garcia, co-founder and CEO of online used car platform, Carvana. Ernie launched Carvana in 2012, and less than a decade later, the business commands a $60 billion valuation while selling a used car every other minute. Our conversation covered a lot of ground.

key_points.text: We discussed effective decision-making, what it means to be a long-term thinker, and what Ernie sees as the defining features of attractive markets.
We then went deep on Carvana itself, covering the original insight, logistics operations.
I think you’ll find Ernie’s insights and energy infectious.
